records.chunk_text: MRI of the knee without contrast is medically necessary when conservative therapy has failed and internal derangement is suspected (persistent locking, instability, suspected meniscal or ligamentous tear). Routine imaging for uncomplicated, self-limited knee pain is not covered.

Screening colonoscopy is covered at defined frequency intervals based on risk. When a screening colonoscopy results in a biopsy or polyp removal, it is still reported as a screening-initiated service and beneficiary cost-sharing rules for preventive screening apply.

CT of the chest without contrast is covered for evaluation of an abnormal chest radiograph, suspected pulmonary nodule, or staging when documented. Repeat CT within a short interval without a change in clinical status may be denied as not medically necessary.

A complete blood count is covered when ordered to evaluate signs/symptoms or monitor therapy. Routine standing orders that generate daily CBCs without a documented indication may be reviewed for medical necessity.

Knee MRI is considered medically necessary after a trial of conservative management (typically 4-6 weeks) unless red-flag findings are present. Documentation of the failed conservative course and the suspected internal derangement is required. (Synthesized fixture.)

Total knee arthroplasty is medically necessary for advanced osteoarthritis with radiographic joint-space loss and persistent pain/functional limitation despite documented non-operative treatment. Cosmetic or convenience indications are not covered. (Synthesized fixture.)

Chest CT without contrast is covered for follow-up of an indeterminate pulmonary nodule or abnormal radiograph. Screening CT outside an approved lung-cancer screening protocol is not a covered indication. (Synthesized fixture.)

Excision of a benign skin lesion is covered when the lesion is symptomatic (bleeding, pain, rapid growth) or there is clinical concern for malignancy. Excision for purely cosmetic reasons is not covered. (Synthesized fixture.)

Advanced outpatient imaging (including knee MRI) requires prior authorization through the radiology benefit manager. Claims submitted without an approved authorization on the date of service may be denied for administrative reasons. (Synthesized fixture.)

Inpatient total knee arthroplasty requires prior authorization with submission of conservative-treatment history and imaging. Authorization is site-of-service specific; an approval for outpatient does not cover an inpatient admission. (Synthesized fixture.)

High-cost advanced imaging requires prior authorization. If a service was rendered emergently and authorization could not be obtained in advance, retrospective review is permitted with documentation of the emergent indication. (Synthesized fixture.)

Claims billed under an unclassified drug code must include the drug name, strength, dosage, and NDC. Claims lacking this detail are pended or denied; the member should not be balance-billed while a coding deficiency is resolved. (Synthesized fixture.)

Blood glucose test strips are covered as durable medical equipment for members with diabetes, subject to quantity limits tied to the prescribed testing frequency. Quantities above the limit require documentation of intensive monitoring. (Synthesized fixture.)

In-network preventive services required under federal law (annual wellness visit, recommended immunizations, age-appropriate preventive exams) are covered at no cost-sharing. A separately significant problem-oriented visit billed the same day may carry standard cost-sharing. (Synthesized fixture.)

Emergency services are covered without prior authorization and out-of-network emergency claims are processed at the in-network cost-sharing level consistent with federal surprise-billing protections. Members should not receive a balance bill for protected emergency services. (Synthesized fixture.)

Advanced imaging for Medicaid members requires prior authorization except when performed in the emergency department. Providers must verify eligibility on the date of service; retroactive eligibility determinations are honored per state rules. (Synthesized fixture.)
